_comment: Dio's voice endpointing. Read fresh when a stream opens, so a change takes effect on the NEXT turn — no restart. A broken file is ignored and the defaults apply; a typo here must never take her hearing offline.
_rule: consecutive = the shipped rule: min_silence_ms of UNBROKEN quiet, reset to zero by any single frame above speech_off. windowed = at least window_frac of the last min_silence_ms below speech_off, so one breath or fan transient no longer restarts the count. Whichever is set, the diagnostics evaluate the OTHER as a shadow and log what it would have done.
_why_it_matters: 13 of 59 speech turns rode Dio's 8s backstop with Silero reporting 0.999 confidence throughout — she was heard, and the turn never got declared over. Grep the journal for 'verdict=counter-reset'; if that is what you see, 'windowed' is the fix.
